slides.title: More room for your work
slides.description: Collapse the sidebar into a compact rail. Your projects, sessions, and workspace controls stay within reach.

media.alt: The Grove sidebar collapsed into a compact rail beside a Cedar terminal.

slides.title: Move projects between workspaces
slides.description: Move a project to another workspace without rebuilding its setup. Keep its worktrees and sessions together.

media.alt: Move to workspace dialog showing Experiments selected for Cedar.

slides.title: Close sessions with confidence
slides.description: Closing a running session asks for confirmation, even from the compact sidebar or keyboard shortcut. Its worktree stays on disk.

media.alt: Grove asks for confirmation before closing a running terminal session.
